violation_type.title: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training - Primary, Assistant, and Substitute Caregivers (26 TAC §747.1313(a))
violation_type.short_title: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training - Primary, Assistant, and Substitute Caregivers
violation_type.typical_finding: The primary caregivers pediatric cpr training expired 09/2023.

finding_variants.text: The primary caregivers pediatric cpr training expired 09/2023.
The CPR/First Aid trainings for both caregivers were not available to review during the inspection.
At the time of the inspection the primary caregiver s First Aid and CPR certification was expired.
Three staff did not have current Pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking training.
The CPR/First-Aid certification for the primary caregiver expired 02/06/2024.
The provider received training on 03/18/2024 on CPR/AED: Adult, Child & Infant + First Aid (BLS). The documentation lacked pediatric first aid and pediatric CPR.
